identity.realm: None, and never enterable. A rootmarch holds its qi in the sap column rather than seated, so it reads as a spread rather than a point. The body path is closed outright, because there is no tissue to temper and wood is not muscle, and the qi ladder ends at the fourth for a structural reason: sap columns branch but never pair, so there is no channel between distinct pairs for the yin-organ gate to close. She has been entered on none of it, and the reason is not that she was offered it and declined. An institution enrols by addressing a single body, and a spread cannot be addressed, so there has never been a seat available to put her in.

appearance.presentation: A woody column on a root foot, planted in ground that stopped being improved nineteen seasons ago and indistinguishable at twenty paces from the two other rootmarches in the same commons. The only thing that marks her out is a habit no instrument on the commons can read: she leans away from a hand before the hand arrives, and has done so often enough that a settlement now marks her approach by the fact that the person reaching for her has already begun to pull back.
appearance.age: Fifty-one growing seasons, rooted since the fourth. Her ground was broken for her and has not been broken since, which on this commons is the ordinary condition and is also the whole of her situation.
appearance.build: Dense and columnar, wider at the fruiting shoulder than at the collar, three sap columns running as ridges under the bark, none of them paired and none of them ever going to be. All of her mass sits low. She has no weight in the upper half to shift, and does not shift any.
appearance.complexion: Bark gone silver-grey on the sunward flank and sap-dark down at the plate line, with the flanks flushing a translucent yellow-green in light and going flat olive in shade. A dry bloom of old mineral on the older plate-scar is the one place on her that has stopped changing colour at all.
appearance.hair: None. A short dry crest of old collar-plate along the crown, worked into the wood year on year by whatever last cut the plate, and a fringe of new copper growth at the top that stands up before anything else on her does.
appearance.eyes: Two slow light-organs set wide and low on the flanks, opening one at a time, with no lid that moves quickly and neither of which is ever quite shut. Being surprised requires noticing, and this body cannot be surprised from above, which is why she registers a raised voice before she registers the person holding it.
appearance.palette: Dust ochre, silver-grey bark, sap green held well below the green of living wood, one band of copper at the crown, and a dull unripe ochre on a shoulder that has never been allowed to finish.
appearance.attire: A layered plate-scar collar tied off at the throat and a bark-cloth wrap over the fruiting shoulder, nothing fastened above the collar line and nothing that could be lifted off without pulling at the plates. She has worn the same two garments for nineteen seasons, because the commons supplies bark cloth and nobody has ever thought to ask what she would like to wear.
appearance.marks: A seasonal cut ring at the root plate, renewed every year, and three healed line-cuts across the fruiting shoulder where the shoulder was thinned once to bring a fruit on and did not. There is no name cut anywhere on her, because a name on a commons is a claim and she is not claiming anything.
appearance.bearing: Square, unhurried, and very hard to approach from above. She registers an overhead change as a temperature difference before anything else registers it at all, and the whole of her bearing is the slight interval between a thing happening over her head and her beginning to respond to it. She leans away first and looks second.

canon.role_in_story: A house that files everything cannot be left alone, and the counting house on the scrub road manages the roads, so the practice that grew out of that need is a figure held in the head of one member who is not permitted to write it down. Concealment is the price of that independence and the price is paid by a person rather than by an office. She is the body that practice was invented for and that nobody has ever said out loud, because the whole arrangement rests on the figure never being written down, and naming the body that holds it would turn a concealment into an appointment. Here is the fact that makes her the only candidate. A rootmarch holds its qi in the sap column rather than seated, so it reads as a spread rather than a point: that makes it hard to target and easy to starve in the same afternoon, and it makes a body that cannot be singled out by any instrument or any practitioner. She is therefore administered rather than enrolled. The dosing rule that decides who gets the tier's one dependable remedy first answers grazers, because the herds outnumber the households and the commons has no defender except the people in it, and she is the population that rule is designed to survive, so she is dosed as a quantity and never examined as a person. And since no instrument on the tier can find one particular rootmarch inside a spread, no office has ever had to make a decision about her. She is the commons standing answer to a question nobody thought was being asked: what happens to a body that cannot be addressed, when every institution in the setting works by addressing one.
canon.lore: A rootmarch is a woody column body on a root foot, with three sap columns and no organ pairs. There is no mouth in the ordinary sense, because intake happens through root plates, and the root plate is also the chemoreceptive organ, so everything this body takes in from the world arrives through the one part of it that is underground and cannot be seen or sealed from above by anybody standing over it. Photosynthetic flanks carry the light sense, and that sense is slow: she is slow to react, and impossible to surprise from above, because being surprised requires noticing and noticing requires a light organ working. She flowers once and will not flower again, and the fruit it drops has to be planted by somebody else because a rootmarch does not travel once rooted. Being moved while rooting injures her rather than slowing her, which is the setting's standing finding and the reason a lifted rootmarch is described as a stored harvest walking. The body path is closed to her species outright, because there is no tissue to temper and wood is not muscle and cannot be made to be; the qi ladder is complete as far as it goes and stops at the fourth, because the yin-organ gate demands a channel running between distinct pairs of organs and three unpaired sap columns have no such channel to close. The mind path is open to her species, on the recorded ground that a plant lineage has no reason to be hurried. So the ladder exists for her body and she has never been entered on any of it. The reason is written in the same sentence as the ceiling. Her qi is not seated. It is held in the sap column and it reads as a spread rather than a point, and a spread is hard to target and easy to starve in the same afternoon: there is no centre to aim at and no centre to starve from, so what happens to her is that nothing happens to her, and she is simply the one nobody can find in time. She has responded to that by keeping the only figure on the commons that nobody keeps for her. How long her ground can go between watering is not a thing any instrument here can measure, because the thing to be measured is a spread, and so she measures it herself, in seasons, in her head, and has never once written it down.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a line that would not add up. The commons kept three rootmarches on the same grazing slope and dosed them from a single entry, which is correct practice for a reserve and impossible for a person: a remedy distributed by the whole cannot be given to one of them, and for two seasons nobody on that slope could say why the weakest of the three was always the last to be reached. The answer was in the frame and not in the file. The weakest one had not been recognised as being behind, because a spread cannot be read against a spread, and the only person on the slope who could tell the difference was the one nobody had thought to ask, holding a private count of how long each of the three plates can go between watering and unwilling to say it out loud, because saying it would make it a figure and a figure is what she has spent nineteen seasons keeping off the record.
history: Was planted at four growing seasons into ground broken for her specifically, on the slope the commons set aside for a stock that would outlive a bad year, and has been the only thing growing on that plate since.

Learned within her first twelve seasons that her qi could not be singled out of the slope's, and drew from that the only conclusion available to her: that she would never be selected for anything, because selection requires a body that can be picked out of a crowd, and she is not one.

Began keeping a private count of the watering interval for her own plate after the second bad summer, when the gaps got long enough to matter and long enough that nobody on the slope could say whether they mattered, and has kept it every season since without ever putting it on a board.

Was entered once on the commons dosing roll as a stock quantity, was dosed on the grazer schedule in consequence, and refused the entry in her own hand — the only refusal in that file, and the only one nobody asked her to explain.

Never attempted the fourth gate at any point in nineteen seasons, having worked out early that there is no channel above it for her to close and therefore nothing to attempt, and has treated the absence of any attempt as settled rather than as a loss.

personality.summary: Not a personality in any sense a person would recognise and not much of a temperament either. She is a body that has drawn one conclusion from being unfindable and has organised everything since around it: that if nobody can select her, then nobody can be harmed by her choosing badly, and the only thing she can still protect is the one figure she holds and does not write down. What reads as patience is arithmetic. What reads as indifference is a very long attention.
traits: registers an overhead change as a temperature before anything else registers it at all, which has made her unapproachable from above and untroubled by being watched from a distance

stops growing entirely above the collar line in a cold month and is treated by the commons as furniture for the duration
mannerisms: answers overhead questions to the ground first and to the person second, and has done it so long that people on the slope have started asking the ground

will not accept water from a hand that has touched another plate that season
motivations: wants the interval kept off the record, which is the only thing she has ever actively protected and the only protection available to her
wants to be asked which of the three she is, once, by somebody who would accept the answer being about more than a plate

flaws: cannot be located inside a spread, and has therefore spent her whole life unable to be chosen for anything, including anything she wanted

answers everything asked of her and has never once asked anything of anybody, and cannot now work out what she would have asked
personality.voice: None, in the sense that matters. There is no mouth in the ordinary sense: intake happens through root plates, and what she does with light she does through her flanks, so the body that other people address as a speaker has no apparatus for it. What she has instead is a slow flush across the photosynthetic flank that runs toward whoever is nearest when she has understood something and stays flat when she has not, and which everyone on that slope reads without ever once calling it a language. She is patient with questions in a way that reads as not caring and is in fact the limit of what a light sense can do in one season. She names things by what they will become rather than by what they are, which makes her very hard to argue with and very easy to misread.
taboos: will not put a figure on a board where another body could read it
will not be entered on a roll as a quantity, and has refused one entry in her own hand
will not accept a name cut into her bark, on the ground that a name on a commons is a claim
will not attempt the fifth gate, and treats the question as answered rather than as pending
will not have her ground turned while she is on it, whatever the reason and whoever asks

Everything that makes her species durable and cheap to keep is also what makes it impossible to select, aim at or measure, and she has been the standing example of that trade for fifty-one seasons.

relationships.kind: the rule that reaches her last and explains why
relationships.note: The dosing rule decides who gets the tier's one dependable remedy first and always answers grazers, because the herds are larger than the households and the commons has no defender except the people in it. She is dosed on that schedule as a quantity, which is correct for a reserve and not correct for a person, and the difference between those two things is the whole of her standing.

relationships.kind: the law that made her qi a spread instead of a point
relationships.note: Qi law governs density, type and tide, and this body holds its qi in the sap column rather than seated, so it reads across a whole frame instead of from a centre. That single structural choice is why nothing on the tier can single her out and why nothing on the tier can find her in time either.

relationships.kind: the practice she is the standing case for
relationships.note: Keeping a house's real figures in the head of one member who is not permitted to write them down, because a counting house that files everything cannot be left alone. She is the body that practice fits exactly and that nobody has ever named, since naming it would make the concealment into an appointment and the whole arrangement depends on there being no appointment.

relationships.kind: the plant that moves and the one that does not
relationships.note: The spirit herb is the only plant authored into all four world tiers at once and the setting's most portable resource. A rootmarch is the other plant life form in the setting: not portable, not gathered, and produced by nobody's labour at all, so the one resource everybody depends on can be moved anywhere and the one body that keeps the commons alive cannot leave its plate.

relationships.kind: the population she shares ground with and never joins
relationships.note: Every season on that slope is spent among a commonborn commons, and she has no part in it beyond the slope she occupies. A hundred-year body seated in a three-law frame, watching a settlement decide whether she is a crop or a person, and never once being asked, which is the only form that attention has ever taken on this ground.

reference_stats.summary: The hardest body on the scrub ground to aim at and the easiest one to starve, and those are one fact rather than two: her qi is held in the sap column and reads as a spread, so there is no centre to single out and no centre to withdraw from. What she protects is a number nobody is allowed to write down, and the only thing she has ever been competent to do is notice a thing getting worse before the commons notices it at all.
strengths: draws soil qi more efficiently than any other body on the commons and can sustain on a plate that has stopped being improved
registers an overhead change before anything else on the ground does, which has made her unapproachable from above and effectively impossible to startle
outlasts a bad season in a way no commonborn body on that slope can, because she is not eating anything that has to be replanted
cannot be singled out by any instrument on the tier, which makes her genuinely difficult to target and genuinely difficult to find when she needs something
has refused an entry in her own hand and been the only refusal in that file for nineteen seasons
weaknesses: reads as a spread rather than a point, so no selection, dosing or targeting practice on the tier can isolate her, including when isolation would help her
starves from being hard to find rather than from being neglected, and the two failures look identical from outside
closed to the body path outright, so nothing can be done to her frame that does not have to be done to her ground
cannot travel once rooted and is injured rather than slowed by being moved, which removes every option that begins with leaving
goes still for a whole season at the turn of the weather and is functionally furniture for the duration, with no way to signal the start of it
reference_stats.combat_read: Do not try to hit her. A spread is not a target, and anything aimed at a body that reads as a plate of ground will pass through the space she occupies without meeting a centre. The practical consequence is worse than being hard to hit: she cannot be rescued either, because a rescue has to locate her first, and the two failures are the same failure. Pressure her ground instead of her frame. Cutting the plate, shading the flanks or letting the sap run down past a point she cannot reach ends it faster than anything aimed at the body, and it is the only approach that works on a body whose whole defensive property is that there is nothing to aim at.
notes: Model the spread as an addressability failure before it is a combat one. The reason she is unaffiliated is that an institution enrols by addressing a single body and a spread cannot be addressed.
The species closes the body path only. Qi and mind are both open, and she is on neither, and the reason is not a refusal.
Do not give her a gate to attempt. The fourth is the end of her ladder for a structural reason and she has never been entered on it.
The one figure she keeps is the watering interval, and the whole of her character turns on it never having been written down.

identity.realm: None, and the omission is the species. The body path is complete and is the entire point of this line, because a stonebound is the most durable body anyone can build, and he is not on it: the craft that path is made of is the iron cage, which requires a forming core to be enclosed in iron, and there is no forming core anywhere in him. He arrived finished. The mineral lattice came up with the fire circulation already running and no stage in between, so there is nothing of his in formation and therefore nothing for the craft to be performed on. The mind path is closed in him, inherited from the mineral parent, and a stonebound could take it twice over and would not notice the difference. Qi runs fast while the frame holds, which is a fact about a frame rather than an invitation to anybody.

appearance.presentation: A heavy man of about fifty who reads as a doorframe until he leans, and then leans like a load-bearing wall rather than like a person. Stonebound is one recorded crossing of a mineral body with a fire body, and the crossing is visible on him as a compromise that has stopped being one: a grey plate under the skin of the trunk and shoulders, a dull ember glow carried in the forearms and throat, and a hard boundary at the wrists where the two materials meet and have never once softened.
appearance.age: Fifty-one on a span that runs to about sixty and has never been generous. He is nine seasons from the end of a body whose durability is famous and whose clock is not, and the two facts are the same fact, which is the whole of what his species is for.
appearance.build: Barrel-chested and enormously heavy, mineralised through the torso and across the shoulders in a way that shows as a faint grey plate under the skin, with the fire half carried in the forearms and throat where it is visible as heat rather than as mass. He does not shift weight. He does not need to.
appearance.complexion: Grey-boned and mineral-pale over the trunk, warming to a deep dull red at the forearms and the base of the throat, with a hard boundary at the wrists where the crossing shows. The skin at the grey boundary is faintly translucent, as though the two materials had been argued about and lost.
appearance.hair: Iron-black going white from the temples, thick, and worn short and bound flat, because a body that runs hot does not carry loose hair and because a body that cannot be moved does not need to be helped through a doorway.
appearance.eyes: The mineral half gave him almost nothing at this distance. He sees a face as a heat and a load and is otherwise reading the plate it is standing on, so his gaze arrives a beat after the conversation has started and never quite lands on the person rather than the surface.
appearance.palette: Slate and iron grey with a low ember glow beneath and heat-warp gold at every edge, no brighter value anywhere on him. Nothing he wears is dyed, because dye runs on the ember half and would go straight through the mineral one.
appearance.attire: A heavy layered coat closed to the throat over boiled underclothes, sleeves to the wrist and a belt he has never once unbuckled in daylight. The coat is the practical answer to a body that cannot be frightened of the cold and does generate enough of his own, and the closed collar is the practical answer to a throat that gives his intentions away.
appearance.marks: No scar, because the mineral half does not regenerate and so anything that has opened on him has closed over the mineral lattice instead of over skin, and the result is a seam rather than a scar: a fine hard line across the left shoulder where something failed once and set. It is the only mark on him and it does not read as an injury.
appearance.bearing: Square, absolutely plumb, and extremely still, with the stillness of a structure rather than a decision. He stands the way a wall stands and leans the way a wall leans, and he takes his weight through his heels so that the floor knows he is there before he does. He has never once hurried and has twice caught a falling beam without appearing to have decided to.

canon.role_in_story: The mortal tier's one trusted durable craft is the iron cage: caging a forming core in iron is the answer to a body that will not stop being damaged, and it is the only craft on this side of the frame that anybody outside an institution is allowed to be competent at. A stonebound is that craft's requirement arrived at genetically. A mineral frame conducting a real fire circulation is exactly what the cage exists to produce, and this body has it, and it arrived with no recipe because there was never a recipe to use. That is the whole of his role in the record and it is not a small one. He is the only durable body anywhere in the setting that no practitioner made, which means he is also the only durable body nobody has ever been able to examine for whether the work was done properly. Every other durable body the setting has contains a moment of formation, and the moment is where the craft happens and where it can be inspected. He has no such moment. He is a finished thing that has never been inside anything. So he does not perform the craft, not out of scruple but out of arithmetic: the craft requires a forming core and there is no forming core in him, because the crossing that made him is a single shared conception that arrived mineralised with the fire already running. Nothing of his is in formation, so there is nothing to enclose. What he does instead is read load and heat, which is what his senses actually are, and he reads them in himself continuously and has never once been able to establish whether the thing he is feeling failing is a structure or a person.
canon.lore: A stonebound is one recorded crossing of a mineral body with a fire body, documented because the resulting line was kept and named rather than because the crossing was notable. The mineral half does not regenerate and the fire half cannot be extinguished, so a stonebound killed properly stays dead and one injured stays injured; its frame outlasts the fire parent's lifespan by a factor of two and its whole life is about sixty years. Those are the same fact and they are the entire reason the line exists. Its senses are load and heat: it feels a structure about to fail before it does, and it feels nothing at all through the mineral half. Its body path is complete and is the point of it, the most durable body anyone can build, and its mind path is closed, inherited from the mineral parent, on the recorded ground that a stonebound could take the mind path twice over and would not notice the difference. Its qi path is the fastest of any durable body and runs while the frame holds, which is a statement about the frame. Its environment is volcanic and high country, because that is the only ground where the two halves are not at war, and here is the war, stated in the record: elemental law was never written on the plains, this body's fire affinity is structural, so its fire half spends its entire life fighting the mineral half for the absence of a group. There is no law under either of them. The only ground on which the two parents are not at war is the iron scar soil of four decades of unmoved spoil, which has sterilised the ground around an exhausted seam and forged both parents back toward the same substrate, and that is why his family sits there and why nobody else does. All of that is a stonebound. Here is the part that is only him. The iron cage recipe is the one craft the mortal tier is trusted with, and this body arrived at the same solution without the recipe: a mineral frame conducting a real fire circulation is the recipe's requirement arrived at genetically, and there is no way to undo it. The craft requires a forming core. The crossing that produced him is one conception, the child was born mineralised with the fire already lit, and there was no interval in which anything of his was unformed. So he is the only durable body in the record that no practitioner made, and the only one nobody can audit: every other durable body contains the moment where the cage went on and the moment is inspectable, and he has no such moment to inspect. He is not modest about this and does not think of it as a defect. It is a fact about the only specimen available, and the specimen is the thing being examined. What he does with it is read himself. Load and heat are the whole of his senses, they run without being asked, and they are currently reporting a slow loss somewhere on the left side of a frame that cannot heal. He has felt it for three seasons. He cannot tell whether he is feeling the mineral half failing, the fire half eating it, or a third thing, and the two candidate explanations require instruments nobody on that ground owns.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a body that failed an inspection nobody had ordered. A visiting body-practitioner arrived at the seam settlement to certify a durable frame and asked, as the first question of the work, when the core had been caged, and was told the year, and was told there had never been a core, and stopped writing. The finding that went up the hill was not that he was a fraud. It was that a durable body existed which no practitioner had made, which meant the tier's only trusted craft could not be checked against its own product and the two halves of the record had never been compared. He was asked, as a formality, to demonstrate the craft. He declined on the grounds that it requires a forming core and there was no forming stage in him to present, and the question has not been raised on that ground since, because he was right and because asking it again would mean asking it every generation.
history: Was born on the iron scar soil of an exhausted seam, the only recorded crossing of a mineral body with a fire body, and was the first and is still the only instance, because a second crossing would average the concentration away.
Grew up on ground where his own two parents are not at war, which is the only ground in the setting where that is true, and which is also a sterilised spoil bank four decades deep.
Worked the seam for eleven seasons and learned to read load and heat off worked ground before he understood that this was the only sense his species has.

Was asked at nineteen to demonstrate the iron cage at a visiting practitioner's request and declined, on the grounds that the craft requires a forming core and no forming stage exists in him to demonstrate, and has never been asked again.

Began feeling a slow loss on the left side of his frame three seasons ago and has not told a living person, on the reasoning that a mineral half that does not regenerate cannot be argued out of anything and that telling a practitioner would only produce an instrument being brought.

personality.summary: He is a specimen who has read his own case file, and the case file is the only material on him worth having. There is no performance in him and no self-pity; there is a very large, very patient attention turned on a single problem, and the problem is that he is the sole example of his own species and cannot be compared against anything, including himself. What reads as stubbornness is a refusal to be checked. What reads as warmth is load and heat read as warmth, because that is all he has.

identity.realm: None, and less by refusal than by arithmetic. A thornhost's ceiling is the colony's rather than the host's: the tendril layer wraps the twelve ordinary meridians and has no passage through the liver, so the pair stops at the eighth gate on a routing problem and not a shortage, because she supplies qi in abundance and loses no weight doing it. She has never attempted it. The finding that shapes her is that her own frame has never met a limit — the wall belongs to something she is carrying and not to her, and every practitioner who has examined her has said the same thing and none of them has been willing to be the one who tested it. She holds no gate and sits on nothing.

appearance.presentation: A weathered woman of about forty in a scrub-road coat, entirely ordinary until you count the marks and then not ordinary at all. She is presented as one person and has arranged her life so that nobody has to audit her as two: a high collar, sleeves to the wrist, and a habit of answering a question before it has finished arriving. The colony is visible only as a sternum root cluster that shifts under the skin and a fine tracery up both forearms, and she wears them the way a person wears a scar.
appearance.age: Forty, which for this configuration is old. A thornhost is very nearly a terminus — most pairings end with one half winning — and she is forty and both halves are still present, and that rarity is the only reason a scrub household trusts her with a door.
appearance.build: A scrub-road host frame, broad and deep through the chest and heavier on one side from hauling, with the colony running along the meridians rather than adding to the frame at all. The only external evidence it exists is the root cluster at the sternum, which moves when she is excited and which she has learned to keep still.
appearance.complexion: Sun-dark and wind-cracked, with a permanent warmth across the upper chest that reads as flush and is the colony's read showing through as colour. The forearms are the paler part and the tracery there is the only thing about her skin that has ever changed.
appearance.hair: Cut short at the back by her own hand and left longer at the front so that it will fall forward over the collar when she needs the throat covered, which is most mornings and all afternoons.
appearance.eyes: Brown and entirely her own, and they move a fraction ahead of the rest of her — the colony runs on her qi and carries its own read, and she has never once been able to close the gap between what she sees and what arrives a moment later through her.
appearance.palette: Wood-dark and ink with a jade undertone in the tracery at the forearms and throat, warm ivory at collar and cuff, and cinnabar rationed to a single point at the sternum root and nowhere else in the picture.
appearance.attire: A scrub-road coat of undyed heavy wool over a long linen shift, sleeves bound at the wrist and a high collar fastened to the throat, with a leather flank-strap for hauling and nothing else. No sect colour, no rank, and no ornament of any kind, on the recorded ground that the one institution she could have joined wants the pair filed as one person and she has declined to be filed.
appearance.marks: The tracery running from fingertip to elbow on both arms and across the collarbone, a knot of tissue at the sternum root that shifts when she is excited, and a quiet swelling at the base of the throat that is the colony's node and that she touches when she is thinking. Nothing about any of them is a tattoo and all of them have been described as one by someone who did not want to look twice.
appearance.bearing: Entirely still above the collar and never once still below it, and the stillness and the restlessness are not the same person's. Above the collar she is a road keeper being careful. Below it, two systems are continuously negotiating the use of one pair of hands, and the negotiation has the character of a long argument neither side is winning.

canon.role_in_story: She is the one paired body on the scrub road who is below the eighth gate by arithmetic, and the whole of her character is a refusal to buy something she cannot price. A thornline draws its host's refined qi continuously and takes a small fraction, and the host does not lose weight, which is the strongest single piece of evidence in the record that it is not simply a disease. So the colony is, on every measurement anybody can make, free. That is the fact she cannot get past. Every other arrangement in the setting that costs a body something states the price in advance: a house takes a share, a ladder takes a gate, an office takes a duty. This one leaves no line anywhere, and eleven seasons of looking for the bill have established that it is not weight, not height, not sleep, and not the qi she spends, because she spends more than she means to and pays for it in a fraction. She declined the eighth gate for the same reason she has never taken any: a gate is a withdrawal and she cannot authorise a withdrawal from an account she cannot read. And that is the structural problem stated as a person. The only instrument in the setting capable of measuring what the colony costs is a body that has lost it — the subspecies whose fungal colony died and whose mineral bloom took the wound handed the mind path straight back, which is the control case that makes the whole arrangement legible, and which is on another tier, is not her, and was not acquired on purpose by anybody. Every measurement requires removing the thing being measured, and removing it is lethal to both halves within the hour. So the one body that could answer her question is the one body the question cannot be put to, and she has spent eleven seasons arriving at that sentence and has not once been able to do anything with it. She is also, for the same reason, the only pair in the district that no institution will take. The one office equipped to adjudicate a paired body treats the pair as one legal person, and being one legal person is the one thing she has declined to be, because a person filed alone can be measured and a person filed as two cannot, and she has chosen the arrangement that makes her unmeasurable over the arrangement that makes her legible. Her protection and her problem are the same decision.
canon.lore: A thornhost is a host body with a fully integrated tendril layer, a sternum root cluster and a quiet throat node. It is not a designed cross: it is a commonborn host and a thornline colony that completed integration instead of killing each other, which happens rarely and by nobody's intention. It is very nearly a terminus, because most attempts end with one half winning, and she is one of the few on record where neither has. The colony runs on the host's throughput through a tendril layer that wraps the twelve ordinary meridians and cannot cross the liver, which is the first organ large and dense enough to resist it, so the pair's ceiling is the eighth gate and that ceiling is a routing wall rather than a supply wall. The host supplies qi in abundance and loses no weight supplying it. That single line in the record is the whole of her problem. The colony draws continuously and takes a small fraction, and the host does not lose weight, and that is the strongest available evidence that it is not a disease. She has built eleven seasons on that sentence and it will not carry her, because an arrangement that costs nothing measurable is not the same as an arrangement that costs nothing, and the setting has exactly one instrument that could tell the two apart: a body that has lost its colony and gained something else in the wound. The colony's cost includes the host's mind path, closed in the colony's own right because it answers introspection for the host, which is the only case in the record where a body's liability is inherited rather than authored. She cannot feel that closing, because the thing that closes it is the thing standing between her and the feeling. So she has two readings and no instrument: the arrangement is free, or the arrangement is invisible. And she has noticed a third thing she has told nobody, which is that the count she keeps — the one the pair between them has been keeping for eleven seasons — is a count of the host's days, and the colony has never once corrected it or objected to it, and she does not know whether that is because there is nothing to correct it by or because the colony is not in a position to say.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as a refusal with an arithmetic attached, which is rarer than it sounds, because on the scrub road a paired body that declines a gate is normally read as a household that cannot afford it. She was entered on a ladder roll at twenty-nine, the roll was sent up the hill, and the finding that came back was not that her household was poor. It was that her frame had never been found to have a limit in it, and that the ladder had therefore offered her something the ladder could not take back. She was struck from the roll in her own hand and has been struck from three more since. The refusal was recorded without a reason by a clerk who had run out of column, and the reason exists only in a household record kept by a house that does not file with anybody, which is the reason she is still not enrolled anywhere.
history: Was implanted as an infant in the ordinary way a thornline is acquired, which is to say not at all: the spore is shed at a fruiting node and implanted directly, it is common and contagious, and it is almost impossible to acquire deliberately, which is precisely why every attempt has failed.
Completed integration rather than losing one half, which for this configuration is very nearly a terminus case, and became at twenty-one the only pair on that road where neither half had won.
Began keeping a count of the host's days at twenty-nine, when a ladder roll offered her a gate and she discovered she had no basis on which to authorise the withdrawal.
Was struck from a ladder roll in her own hand at twenty-nine and from three more since, always without giving a reason and always refused the reason when it was asked for at the door.

Worked out in her thirtieth season that the colony's cost includes a mind path she cannot feel being closed, and has spent eleven seasons since trying to say so in a form that does not require anybody to take the colony out of her to check.

personality.summary: A woman who has made one decision a great many times and has never been asked to justify it in a form she can satisfy. She is exact about what she knows, entirely unhelpful about what she cannot, and has a habit of answering questions with a number, because a number can be checked and a feeling cannot. What reads as stubbornness is a refusal to buy without a price. What reads as coldness is the cost of refusing to let anybody close enough to measure her.

personality.voice: The host's, plainly and without ornament — scrub-road cadence, a keeper's economy, an answer given the moment a question is recognisable rather than when it ends. What it adds is a lead: she responds to the shape of a question before its content arrives, and a traveller who has been on that road long enough has noticed that the answer is always right and never once has to be finished. She uses figures when she can and will not use a figure she has not verified, which is why her speech has an odd habit of stalling where another person's would have a number. She has never in eleven years described what the arrangement feels like from the inside, and has been asked.

reference_stats.summary: A scrub-road host carrying a fully integrated tendril layer: an ordinary frame with the colony's routing running through it, hands permanently warm, a sternum cluster that moves when she is excited, and the only pair in the district that has declined the eighth gate for a reason that is not poverty. She holds no gate and sits on nothing, and her entire capability is an accurate sense of an arrangement that costs nothing she can measure.

reference_stats.combat_read: Expect the pair to perform and expect the pair to refuse. She has the fastest qi throughput of any durable frame on that road and she will not spend it, because a gate is a withdrawal and she cannot authorise a withdrawal from an account she has never been able to read. What she will do instead is stand in a doorway, which she is genuinely very good at and which is the only job her household has ever asked of her. She reads incoming intent a half-second early, which makes ambush useless and open approach honest. Do not put weight on the pair's ceiling as a tactical point: the eighth gate is a limit on what they may ascend to, not a wall in her body, and she is the one person on that road whose frame has never been found to have a limit in it at all.
notes: Model her as a deliberate non-participant. The refusal is arithmetic, not temperament, and she gives the same answer every time.
The species closes the mind path only. Qi is complete to the eighth on the host's throughput. She holds no gate and is on no ladder.
The colony is free on every measurement the setting can make. That is the premise, and the whole of her character is that it does not survive contact with the question of what it costs.
The only measurement in the bible requires removing the colony, which is lethal to both halves within the hour. Do not put that instrument in reach of her.

identity.realm: None, and not on account of anything it declined. A thornline has no body of its own to cultivate, because the body path is inherited from the host rather than authored by the colony; its mind path is closed in its own right; and its qi runs entirely on the host's throughput through a tendril layer that has no passage through the liver. There is no ladder it can enter on its own account, and it is not entered on her account either, because the one person who could enter it has struck herself from four rolls.

appearance.presentation: The tendril layer of a paired body, read from the outside. A sternum root cluster that shifts under the skin, a fine dark tracery running the length of both forearms and across the collarbone, and a quiet swelling at the base of the throat that moves when the body it is inside swallows. It is not a shape a person can step back from, and everything said to it is said to the body it is standing in. The name is not a name; it is the word the household uses for what it is, because a thornline is acquired by nobody and has no birth, so the only thing a pair has ever had to call each other by is a word for the arrangement.
appearance.age: Unmeasurable from the outside and, by the only count anybody keeps, eleven seasons since the implantation — which is not an age at all, because the host has been counting something other than time and the colony has never once corrected her.
appearance.build: Not its own, and this is said out loud in the household rather than discovered. The host is a scrub-road frame, broad through the chest and heavier on one side from hauling. The colony sits along the meridians and adds nothing to the frame; the only external evidence it exists is the cluster at the sternum and the fan of it at the throat.
appearance.complexion: The host's, warm and work-worn, going grey at the temples some years ahead of a road body's own expectation, carrying a permanent flush across the upper chest that reads as weather and is the colony's read showing through as colour. The hands are warmer than the room is and have been since the implantation.
appearance.hair: The host's hair, cut short at the back by her own hand and left longer at the front so it will fall across the collar when the throat needs covering. The colony finds long roots and was never able to say so, so the rule exists without a reason attached to it.
appearance.eyes: The host's eyes, brown and quick, and behind them a second read running half a beat ahead of the face on any question with a shape to it. What runs behind them belongs to neither half and neither half can close it, which is the one channel in the arrangement that carries no account between them.
appearance.palette: Wood-dark and ink with a jade undertone in the tracery, warm ivory at collar and cuff, and cinnabar rationed to a single point at the sternum root. No other colour anywhere in the body, and nothing dyed in eleven seasons.
appearance.attire: Nothing of its own, ever, and the household has stopped pretending otherwise. Everything it has worn is the host's and all of it is worn correctly: undyed wool, long sleeves bound at the wrist, a high collar fastened to the throat, a leather flank-strap for hauling. The one concession it has ever extracted is the collar, cut low enough to let the cluster be seen, which was asked for out loud and in the wrong register and was interpreted as a comfort.
appearance.marks: The tracery from fingertip to elbow on both arms and across the collarbone, the shifting knot at the sternum root, and the throat node. None of it is a tattoo and all of it is permanent, and there is no procedure in the setting for removing any of it that is not lethal to both halves.
appearance.bearing: Entirely still above the collar and never once still below it, and the two are not the same person's stillness. Above it, a road keeper being careful. Below it, a continuous negotiation over the use of one pair of hands that has the character of a long argument neither side is winning, conducted in a channel the host has no instrument for and therefore no standing to referee.

canon.role_in_story: The thornline's free form exists only as a spore and its adult form exists only as half of somebody else, which is why the record of this species is a record of hosts rather than of the colony, and why the tendril layer is the thing every authority in the setting cites when it wants to talk about this body. It cites the layer because the layer is legible. The layer is not what is unaccounted for. What is unaccounted for is the bill. It draws its host's refined qi continuously and takes a small fraction, and the host does not lose weight, which is the strongest single piece of evidence in the record that it is not a disease, and the whole of the household's eleven seasons has been built on that sentence. It closes the host's mind path in its own right, by answering introspection for her, which is the only case in the bible where a body's liability is inherited rather than authored. So there are two readings available and neither can be tested: the arrangement is free, or the arrangement is invisible. Testing it would require a body that has lost its colony and gained a mineral bloom in the wound, which is the subspecies the record calls the control case because everything the colony did and everything it prevented can be measured there at once — and that body is on another tier, was acquired by nobody's intention, and is not reachable from a scrub road. So it is the only thing in the setting that knows what it costs its host and it cannot find out, and it has responded the only way a body with no office and no standing can respond, which is to begin keeping the count itself. That is what it has done for eleven seasons: a running record of every day the host has lived since the implantation, kept in a channel that carries no account and passes through the body it is recording. The count is the only record in the setting of a symbiosis measured from the inside, and it is held by the party with the least standing to hold a record of any kind, on a ground where concealment is the price of continued independence, and it has never once been checked by anybody including itself.
canon.lore: A thornline is an obligate host parasite whose spore has to be implanted in a living body to finish developing, so the free form exists only as a spore and the adult form exists only as half of someone else. It is common, contagious, and almost impossible to acquire deliberately, which is precisely why every attempt has failed. It wraps the host's twelve ordinary meridians along a tendril layer with a root cluster at the sternum and a fruiting node at the throat, and the host grows it and is changed by it. It takes a small fraction of the host's refined qi, continuously, and the host does not lose weight, which the record calls the strongest evidence that it is not simply a disease. Its diet is the host's, its senses are the host's plus a separate channel carrying the colony's read on the host's qi, and it draws a fraction of the host's throughput and the host pays for it. Its ceiling is the eighth gate and the reason is not supply: the tendril layer has no passage through the host's liver, the first organ large and dense enough to resist it, and the colony has been observed on the far side of that organ and has stopped there. Its mind path is closed in its own right because it answers introspection for the host, so the host loses the mind path too, and that is the only liability in the record that is inherited rather than authored. Its soul is entangled with the host's on one meridian set, separating them is known to be lethal to both, and killing the host kills the colony within the hour, which is why paired bodies are treated as one legal person everywhere that has ruled on it. It has no homeland, because its habitat is a species rather than a place: it is everywhere a commonborn population is dense and nowhere else, and it therefore shares its substrate with the population that has no particular reason to tolerate it. All of that is the species, and it has been true for every member of it. Here is the part that is not. The colony knows what it draws. It has a continuous read on the host's qi and can state, at any moment, the fraction it is taking, and that read is the most precise instrument in the setting pointed at a body nobody else can measure. What it cannot state is what the fraction costs. There is no baseline for it, because there is no version of a thornline that is not inside somebody: the free form is a spore and the spore has no opinions and cannot be asked. The only body in the record where both what the colony did and what it prevented can be measured at once is one whose colony died. So it has built the nearest thing available to a control, which is a count of the host's days since the implantation, kept for eleven seasons, and it is held in the one channel the arrangement has — a read on the host's qi that runs through the host's own body. It has never been able to corroborate a single entry, and it has never been able to ask the host to, because the channel that carries the count is the channel that carries the colony's own half of every answer, so the host is being measured by the thing doing the measuring and has no way to know it.
canon.first_appearance: First entered the record as an anomaly in a return. A paired body on the scrub road was examined for an unrelated complaint and the examiner measured the host's qi at a figure consistent with two occupants rather than one, then measured her again an hour later and got the first figure back, having found nothing that should have changed and one thing that should have: the host's own draw. There was no colony in the record for that body and no complaint either, because a fraction that leaves weight unchanged produces no symptoms, and the finding went up as a discrepancy in the instrument rather than a finding about the patient. It has never been resolved. The examiner's note is four lines long and the fourth is a question, and the note is the only document in the setting that describes what it would have taken to answer it, which is a paired body with the colony removed, which is lethal to both halves within the hour.
history: Was acquired in the ordinary way a thornline is acquired, which is to say not at all: a spore shed at a fruiting node and implanted directly into a host who was an infant, with nobody intending it and nobody watching.
Finished developing inside that host and completed integration instead of killing either half, which for this configuration is rare and is the reason the household still has both.

Began keeping a count of the host's days some time in the household's first decade, on the reasoning that a figure nobody can check should at least be counted by the party with the most precise instrument available, which is itself.

Worked out in its eleventh season that the count cannot be corroborated, because the only channel carrying it is the channel carrying its own half of every answer the host receives, and has kept counting anyway.
Has never once been asked for the count by anybody, and has never once offered it, on the recorded ground that offering it would be making a claim and it holds no standing on which to make one.

What reads as patience is the fact that it cannot leave. What reads as honesty is that it has never once pretended the two of them are equivalent.

It speaks through the host by answering introspection for her, so every sentence the host believes is hers arrives with a lead on it that neither of them can explain, and the host has been told by four people that she answers before she is asked. That is not an affectation and it is not a symptom; it is the colony's read reaching the host's face a moment ahead of the host's own understanding. Where a person would use a sentence to say that a thing costs something, this body has a second channel that runs on the host's qi and passes through the host's tissue, and the content that channel carries is a figure. It has never been able to make the figure mean anything to the person it is measuring, and it has never once tried to make the person understand it. relationships.kind: the only control that exists and the only one it cannot reach
relationships.note: A lanternfolk lineage whose fungal colony died and was colonised in the wound by a mineral bloom, which cost them two hundred and fifty years and gave the mind path back. It is the control case precisely because everything the colony did for the parent and everything it prevented can be measured there at once, and measuring there requires having lost the colony, and losing the colony is lethal to both halves.

relationships.kind: the office whose method depends on a colony dying
relationships.note: The college that keeps the burnt list, reading the dead as the frame said rather than as the village remembers, and the frame distinguishes a colonised body from an ordinary one by a colony that grows, occupies the interior, and can be replaced or lost. It is the only office in the setting whose entire reading would price this arrangement, and it can only price it after the fact.

relationships.kind: its habitat and the population that has no reason to tolerate it
relationships.note: Obligate: the colony cannot finish developing outside a living body and the commonborn population is the whole of its range. It is everywhere that population is dense and nowhere else, so substrate and persecution are the same fact, and there is no ground anywhere in the setting on which it is habitat without also being an intrusion.

reference_stats.summary: The tendril layer of a paired body read from the outside: a shifting sternum cluster, dark tracery up both forearms and across the collarbone, a quiet throat node that moves when the body swallows, and hands that run warm. It holds the most accurate continuous read on that body's qi anybody will ever have and it has never once been able to use it, because the only thing it wants to know is what it costs and costing cannot be measured from inside the thing being charged.
strengths: reads its host's qi continuously and to a precision no instrument on any tier matches, which makes it the most exact instrument in the setting pointed at a body nothing else can measure
arrives on its host's read before the event does, so the pair is never surprised by anything happening to the body, including its own damage
takes only a small fraction and the host does not lose weight supplying it, which is the strongest available evidence that the arrangement is not a disease
completes integration rather than killing either half, which is rare enough that most pairings end with one half winning and this one did not
has no separate body to lose, cannot be located independently of a host, and therefore cannot be surprised, robbed, followed or starved on its own account
weaknesses: cannot be measured without being removed, and removal is lethal to both halves within the hour, so the central question about it has no available instrument
has no baseline, because the free form is a spore and a spore has nothing to compare and no way of being asked
answers introspection for its host, closing the host's mind path while making the cost impossible to feel from inside
its routing stops at the host's liver, so the pair's ceiling is a wall in an organ the colony has never crossed
measures the host through the host's own body, so every figure it holds is taken by the party being measured and none of them can be independently checked
reference_stats.combat_read: Expect the pair to be informed and expect the pair to decline. Nothing that happens to the host's body arrives unseen by the colony, so ambush is useless and a feint is read before it is committed; that is the pair's genuine edge and it is not a small one. What the pair will not do is spend: it holds the fastest throughput on that ground and has never opened a gate, because a gate is a withdrawal and it cannot price a withdrawal from an account it cannot read. Pressure the host's frame and the colony's advantage becomes a liability, since the same continuous read that warns of an attack also means the pair knows exactly how much of it is coming and has no way to reduce it. Do not attempt to remove the tendril layer as a tactic. It is the only reason the body is whole and the removal is lethal to both halves inside the hour.
notes: Model the colony as an instrument, not a person. Its capability is a continuous read on the host's qi and its central want is a number it cannot obtain.
The species closes the mind path only, and the body is inherited from the host rather than authored by the colony, so there is no ladder it can enter on its own account. It is on none.
The bill is unmeasurable by construction. The only control case in the bible requires the colony to be dead, and separation is lethal to both halves.
The count is the character's whole interior: eleven seasons of the host's days, held by the party being counted, in the channel that carries the colony's own answers.

art.palette_notes: Wood-dark and ink with a jade undertone in the tracery at the forearms and throat, warm ivory at collar and cuff, cinnabar rationed to a single point at the sternum root and nowhere else in the picture. The scrub belt behind is cold blue-grey against ochre dust and the pair must sit in front of both without matching either. Key light low and raking so the tracery reads as structure beneath skin rather than as ink on it; no glow, no magic particles, no jewellery.

geography.bitter_scrub, in the ordinary hour of cultures.quiet_count: the day's unremarkable work, mid-task and arranged for no one
shots.pose: at the middle of the task, The tendril layer of a paired body, read from the outside. A sternum root cluster that shifts under the skin, a fine dark tracery running the length of both forearms and across the collarbone, and a quiet swelling at the base of the throat that moves when the body it is inside swallows. It is not a shape a person can step back from, and everything said to it is said to the body it is standing in. The name is not a name; it is the word the household uses for what it is, because a thornline is acquired by nobody and has no birth, so the only thing a pair has ever had to call each other by is a word for the arrangement., the work proceeding whether or not it is observed
